---
title: "JQI_SatisfiedDemocracy_Race"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}

# ============================================================
# Objective Job Quality, Race, and Satisfaction with Democracy
#
# Question:
# Do Black and White respondents differ in the associations
# between objective employment-quality dimensions and
# satisfaction with democracy?
#
# Outcome:
#   democratic_satisfaction
#
# JQI dimensions:
#   compensation
#   benefits
#   earnings_stability
#
# Race:
#   White
#   Black
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. Packages
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(car)


# ============================================================
# 2. Load data
# ============================================================

gss_all <- readRDS(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "gss_job_quality_primary_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Construct satisfaction with democracy
# ============================================================

gss_all <- gss_all %>%
  mutate(
    satdemoc_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(satdemoc)),
    
    democratic_satisfaction = case_when(
      satdemoc_num == 1 ~ 4,
      satdemoc_num == 2 ~ 3,
      satdemoc_num == 3 ~ 2,
      satdemoc_num == 4 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. Construct race variable
# ============================================================

gss_all <- gss_all %>%
  mutate(
    race_group = case_when(
      racecen1 == 1 ~ "White",
      racecen1 == 2 ~ "Black",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    race_group = factor(
      race_group,
      levels = c("White", "Black")
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Analytic sample
# ============================================================

jqi_satdem_race <- gss_all %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(democratic_satisfaction),
    !is.na(race_group),
    !is.na(compensation),
    !is.na(benefits),
    !is.na(earnings_stability)
  )

nrow(jqi_satdem_race)

table(
  jqi_satdem_race$race_group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

n_distinct(jqi_satdem_race$year)

n_distinct(jqi_satdem_race$industry_common)


# ============================================================
# 6. Exposure differences by race
# ============================================================

race_exposure_means <- jqi_satdem_race %>%
  group_by(race_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    compensation = mean(compensation, na.rm = TRUE),
    benefits = mean(benefits, na.rm = TRUE),
    earnings_stability = mean(
      earnings_stability,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

race_exposure_means


# Black − White differences

race_exposure_difference <- race_exposure_means %>%
  select(
    race_group,
    compensation,
    benefits,
    earnings_stability
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -race_group,
    names_to = "dimension",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = race_group,
    values_from = mean
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    black_minus_white = Black - White
  )

race_exposure_difference


# ============================================================
# 7. Unadjusted racial difference in democratic satisfaction
# ============================================================

m_satdem_race <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~ race_group,
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

summary(m_satdem_race)


# ============================================================
# 8. Separate race × JQI interaction models
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8a. Compensation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_race_comp <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group,
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

summary(m_satdem_race_comp)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b. Benefits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_race_benefits <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    benefits * race_group,
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

summary(m_satdem_race_benefits)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8c. Earnings stability
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_race_earnings <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    earnings_stability * race_group,
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

summary(m_satdem_race_earnings)


# ============================================================
# 9. Fully joint race × JQI model
# ============================================================

m_satdem_jqi_race <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group +
    benefits * race_group +
    earnings_stability * race_group,
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

summary(m_satdem_jqi_race)


# ============================================================
# 10. Joint test of all racial differences in JQI slopes
# ============================================================

linearHypothesis(
  m_satdem_jqi_race,
  c(
    "compensation:race_groupBlack = 0",
    "benefits:race_groupBlack = 0",
    "earnings_stability:race_groupBlack = 0"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 11. VIF diagnostics
# ============================================================

vif(m_satdem_jqi_race)


# ============================================================
# 12. Implied JQI slopes by race
# ============================================================

coef_full_race <- coef(m_satdem_jqi_race)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compensation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

comp_slopes <- tibble(
  race = c("White", "Black"),
  compensation = c(
    coef_full_race["compensation"],
    coef_full_race["compensation"] +
      coef_full_race["compensation:race_groupBlack"]
  )
)

print(comp_slopes)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Benefits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

benefits_slopes <- tibble(
  race = c("White", "Black"),
  benefits = c(
    coef_full_race["benefits"],
    coef_full_race["benefits"] +
      coef_full_race["benefits:race_groupBlack"]
  )
)

print(benefits_slopes)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Earnings stability
# ------------------------------------------------------------

earnings_slopes <- tibble(
  race = c("White", "Black"),
  earnings_stability = c(
    coef_full_race["earnings_stability"],
    coef_full_race["earnings_stability"] +
      coef_full_race[
        "earnings_stability:race_groupBlack"
      ]
  )
)

print(earnings_slopes)


# ============================================================
# 13. Year-specific race × JQI models
# ============================================================

satdem_race_year_models <- jqi_satdem_race %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      model <- lm(
        democratic_satisfaction ~
          compensation * race_group +
          benefits * race_group +
          earnings_stability * race_group,
        data = .x
      )
      
      tidy(model)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

satdem_race_year_models


# Save year-specific results

write_csv(
  satdem_race_year_models,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_SatisfactionDemocracy_Race_YearResults.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Temporal heterogeneity in JQI associations
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Restricted model:
# common JQI slopes and common race differences across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_race_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group +
    benefits * race_group +
    earnings_stability * race_group +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year) +
    race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Full model:
# JQI × race relationships allowed to vary by year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_race_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group * factor(year) +
    benefits * race_group * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Omnibus test of three-way temporal heterogeneity
# ------------------------------------------------------------

anova(
  m_satdem_race_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_race_time_full
)


# ============================================================
# 15. Focused temporal test:
#     Does the compensation × race association
#     vary across years?
# ============================================================

m_satdem_comp_race_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group +
    benefits * race_group +
    earnings_stability * race_group +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year) +
    race_group * factor(year) +
    benefits * race_group * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

m_satdem_comp_race_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group * factor(year) +
    benefits * race_group * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

anova(
  m_satdem_comp_race_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_comp_race_time_full
)


# ============================================================
# 16. Focused temporal test:
#     Does the benefits × race association
#     vary across years?
# ============================================================

m_satdem_benefits_race_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group +
    benefits * race_group +
    earnings_stability * race_group +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year) +
    race_group * factor(year) +
    compensation * race_group * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

m_satdem_benefits_race_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group * factor(year) +
    benefits * race_group * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

anova(
  m_satdem_benefits_race_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_benefits_race_time_full
)


# ============================================================
# 17. Focused temporal test:
#     Does the earnings stability × race association
#     vary across years?
# ============================================================

m_satdem_earnings_race_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group +
    benefits * race_group +
    earnings_stability * race_group +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year) +
    race_group * factor(year) +
    compensation * race_group * factor(year) +
    benefits * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

m_satdem_earnings_race_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * race_group * factor(year) +
    benefits * race_group * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem_race
)

anova(
  m_satdem_earnings_race_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_earnings_race_time_full
)


# ============================================================
# 18. Save primary race model results
# ============================================================

satdem_race_model_results <- bind_rows(
  tidy(m_satdem_race) %>%
    mutate(model = "Race only"),
  
  tidy(m_satdem_race_comp) %>%
    mutate(model = "Compensation × race"),
  
  tidy(m_satdem_race_benefits) %>%
    mutate(model = "Benefits × race"),
  
  tidy(m_satdem_race_earnings) %>%
    mutate(model = "Earnings stability × race"),
  
  tidy(m_satdem_jqi_race) %>%
    mutate(model = "Joint JQI × race")
)

write_csv(
  satdem_race_model_results,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_SatisfactionDemocracy_Race_ModelResults.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 19. Session information
# ============================================================

sessionInfo()
